title: Stick with the one color tulips.
text: Stick with the one color tulips.. I bought these two-color tulips (white and pink) because I was so pleased with the white ones I had ordered earlier. While the petals and leaves are as lifelike as the white ones were, the two colors did not work especially well, most specifically the pink. It looked artificial.  Stick with single colors and you will be much happier. I have received lots of favorable comments on my all white tulips.
